name: RAGHAV MEHRA
pullQuote: “We turned a student marketing society into a high-octane agency. From securing title sponsorships with Fortune 500 FMCGs to packing the SVC auditorium to maximum fire capacity, MAC set the gold standard.”
fullLetter: During my presidential tenure, our mandate was aggressive expansion. We rebuilt our brand guidelines from scratch, instituted the first live-simulation war rooms for Zeal, and raised our corporate sponsorship corpus by 140%.

What makes MAC rare is the absence of complacency. In this society, average work gets dissected on the whiteboard immediately, but great work is celebrated and shared with thousands of marketers across Delhi.
Wear the badge with pride. Build things that outlast your college degree, and always prioritize the operators who stand by you in the war room.
